intro_en: CNMO 2024 is the Chinese Mathematical Society's official 2024 national high-school mathematics olympiad problem set reused as an evaluation item by DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-R1, Kimi K2, and other model reports, rather than a separately constructed benchmark. It compares stable correctness of full Chinese olympiad solutions.
scale_en: Official 2024 CNMO problem set; model reports do not disclose a separate package count
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the Chinese Mathematical Society competition page, DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report arXiv:2412.19437 Section 5.3.1 and Table 6, the official DeepSeek-R1 repository, and the official Kimi K2 repository. CNMO 2024 is the official 2024 Chinese National High School Mathematics Olympiad problem set reused for model evaluation, not a separately authored benchmark paper or newly curated dataset. The DeepSeek-V3 report evaluates CNMO 2024 at temperature 0.7, averages results over 16 runs, limits output to 8,192 tokens, and reports Pass@1. Kimi K2 uses the same named evaluation item and reports Avg@16. Neither model report documents a separately released CNMO evaluation package, an independent item count, or a detailed correctness-judge implementation, so the diagram deliberately does not invent those details.
